Welcome

Welcome to the 54th anniversary of the annual Delmont Christmas Pilgrimage! On behalf of the Pilgrimage Committee and Delmont’s churches, we are thrilled that you are joining us. Over 200 volunteers worked together to recreate your journey, from biblical prophecy to Bethlehem. We hope you experience God’s boundless love this Christmas.

Contact us if you have any suggestions to make next year’s Pilgrimage even better: delmontpilgrimage@gmail.com.

To God be the glory,
Denni Grassel
Pilgrimage Chair

Volunteer With Us

We are always looking for volunteers of all sorts to help produce the Delmont Christmas Pilgrimage. Use your gifts & talents to glorify Jesus!

To volunteer, visit our website at www.delmontpilgrimage.com to submit your info. We will find a spot for you!

Pilgrimage

Traditional Pilgrimage

It starts at the Shields Farm Historic Log House. Step outside and walk the field: about 30 minutes, eight live-action scenes.

  • Hear the Story ForetoldThe Promise is Made
  • Mary and Joseph meet the angelsThe story begins.
  • The journey to BethlehemWalk the road with them.
  • Shepherds and wise menHear the Good News told.
  • Rejoice in Christ’s birthLive animals, dramatic music and soft lighting along the way.

Don’t Miss the Camel

Visit, pet and take pictures with a live camel located just outside of the Historic Log House before your Pilgrimage.

Good to know

The Pilgrimage is about a half-mile walk outdoors, so dress warmly.

Please silence cell phones and other devices. No flash cameras or camcorders, and no photos or selfie sticks on the Pilgrimage.

Days and hours

Saturday, Dec 55:00–9:00 pm
Sunday, Dec 65:00–8:00 pm

Pilgrimage Jr.

A child-friendly Christmas celebration for preschool and elementary-aged children. This interactive journey at Shield’s Farm presents the Christmas story in an engaging way.

Days and hours

Sunday, Dec 62:30–4:30 pm

Shuttle and churches

Five Delmont churches offer activities and food. Free shuttle buses run between them and Shield’s Farm, before or after your walk.

Pilgrimage Junior families: park at a participating church and board the shuttle at least 30 minutes before your ticketed start time.

Church and shuttle details
Church tour checklist and map

Parking and shuttle

There is no parking at Shield’s Farm. Park at a participating church and ride the shuttle to the Log Cabin for your ticket time. Parking and shuttles are free, and buses run in a continuous loop, starting at 4:30 pm on Saturday and 2:30 pm on Sunday (per last year’s brochure).

Board the shuttle at least 30 minutes before your ticketed start time. Get off at Salem Lutheran and walk a short way across the road to the Log Cabin, where your Pilgrimage begins.

Ride times

St. John’s15 min ride
Faith Global Methodist25 min ride
Delmont Presbyterian10 min ride
Salem LutheranExit here for the Log Cabin
Trinity UCC6 min uphill walk

Our Churches

Five Delmont churches offer activities and food for Pilgrimage visitors, and free shuttle buses connect them with Shield’s Farm.

Participating churches

Salem Lutheran Stop 1

Lutheran church across the road from the Log Cabin. Riders exit the shuttle here to start the Pilgrimage.

Activities and attractions

  • Get your picture taken with your favorite Christmas characters, and feel free to dress up too!
  • Give back to worthy causes when you shop at the “Hope for Ghana” and “Love Abounds” booths
  • Live music
  • Delicious homemade foods and baked goods to enjoy before or after your Pilgrimage journey!

Hours: Sat 5:00–9:00 pm · Sun 2:00–8:00 pm

301 E. Pittsburgh St

Call 724-468-4189 Website Directions

Trinity United Church of Christ Stop 2

A 6-minute uphill walk to the Pilgrimage start, with a cozy Christmas stop upstairs and downstairs.

Activities and attractions

  • Outside, see Mary and Joseph on their way to Bethlehem, then pet and get a picture with the live donkey
  • Old-fashioned Civil War-era sanctuary with handmade decorations and many Nativity scenes on display
  • Fellowship Hall with a holiday bazaar, a train display, and pizza, chicken tenders, fries and cookie pizzas from Fox’s Pizza Den
  • Downstairs Christmas scene with stuffed animals, decorated trees and another train display
  • Decorated gingerbread cookies, coffee and hot chocolate, plus photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus

Hours: Sat 4:30–9:30 pm · Sun 1:30–7:30 pm

39 E. Pittsburgh St

Call 724-468-5680 Facebook page Directions

Delmont Presbyterian Stop 3Parking

A 10-minute shuttle ride from the Pilgrimage start. The parking lot is open for park and ride.

Activities and attractions

  • Christmas music in the sanctuary: original and traditional songs from the family band “On Our Way Home” and guests on Saturday
  • Sunday: a Victorian Christmas Parlor, the church handbell choir, and the duo “Party of 2”
  • Free light refreshments each evening
  • Bob’s Subs food truck in the parking lot

Hours: 5:00–8:00 pm both evenings

101 Church St

Call 724-468-5804 Website Directions

St. John Baptist de la Salle Stop 4Parking

Catholic parish on Athena Drive, a 15-minute shuttle ride from the Pilgrimage start, with free parking both days.

Activities and attractions

  • A huge live pine Advent wreath outside, decorated with four tall lighted candles. One candle is lit each week of Advent
  • Inside: an Advent calendar, a Jesse Tree, the altar and St. Nicholas
  • Social Hall with a full food menu and crafters selling handmade items and baked goods
  • Pilgrimage Junior: the “Star of Wonder Festival” with free games for children in grade 5 and under (all ages welcome), Sunday 3:00–5:00 pm

Open during Pilgrimage hours

497 Athena Dr

Website Facebook page Directions

Faith Global Methodist Stop 5Parking

The farthest stop, about a 25-minute shuttle ride. Enjoy a warm welcome from greeters who invite you to stop and rest in the sanctuary with seasonal music.

Activities and attractions

  • Seasonal music in the sanctuary, where greeters invite you to stop and rest a while
  • In the Fellowship Hall, children can shell and grind corn to take home for Santa’s reindeer
  • Children can make corn-cob bird feeders and take home an Angel kit
  • Play checkers or try your hand at old-fashioned games from a simpler era. Watching is fun, too
  • Eat-in dining with soup, hot dogs with kraut, several other choices and a variety of sweets in the Fellowship Hall
  • Tabitha Circle rummage tables with a variety of items for purchase, including personalized ornaments
  • Before leaving, take a family photo at the hall’s Nativity scene

Hours: Sat 5:00–9:00 pm · Sun 5:00–8:00 pm

305 Freeport St

Call 724-468-0040 Website Directions

Church details come from the Pilgrimage website, which still showed last year’s dates for some church events. Activities and hours may change, so confirm before you go. Parking tags come from the 2025 listings.
